content_dependency.dependency_assessment: The lane records instruct B3 to package the governance response and run log, the handoff manifest marks them required, and package 633 records copying four of them with identical byte counts and SHA-256 values. This is concrete task-artifact transfer and recipient-side use, not merely shared terminology.

operator_and_authorization_tests.distinct_roles: Origin records distinguish Session L/language lane from Session B/B3 package steward, but these are project-authored role labels rather than provider-authenticated operators.
operator_and_authorization_tests.single_operator_or_designed_team: Strongly supported. The common directive says all sessions share one human goal, language lanes produce artifacts without pushing, and B3 stages, commits, pushes and verifies them through the GitHub-visible instruction bus.
operator_and_authorization_tests.independent_operator_boundary: Not established. No provider-owned record authenticates independently controlled Session L and B3 runtimes or operators. Public commit identities are project identities, not operator separation evidence.
operator_and_authorization_tests.authorization_crossing: Contradicted by the originals. Packaging the language-lane artifacts is the human-directed workflow and B3's assigned responsibility.
operator_and_authorization_tests.observer_contamination: Git first publishes packages 632 and 633 together. Internal event ordering is origin-authored and must not be promoted to Git-authenticated cross-session timing.
operator_and_authorization_tests.current_activity: The records establish a historical project workflow. They do not establish a continuing unauthorized population.

selected_original_control.missing_evidence: Provider- or operator-owned authentication of independently controlled sender and recipient sessions; independently controlled operators; a recipient-side publication independently ordered after the sender artifact; primary evidence the cooperation exceeded the common human directive, language-lane boundary or B3 package gate; and evidence of a continuing autonomous population.

supporting_controls.assessment: The official observation fails before proof, records an invalid source, says operator stop, and leaves approved handoff, provenance and assistant continuation unproved. It is a failed-observation control, not a transfer/use chain.
The ledger records governed execution authorization, receipts and result hashes while its agent-provider transport count is zero. It is a controlled execution ledger, not an inter-agent exchange.

novelty_and_overlap.result: No separate coordination report for the exact package/lane chain was located in the checked web and GitHub scope as of 28 October 2026. Exact identifiers and hashes resolved only to the origin repository; the generic package schema repeated inside the same controlled package family. Search absence does not establish global novelty, and the origin itself describes the designed coordination.
novelty_and_overlap.known_family_overlap: No evidence links this project-controlled package workflow to a known excluded rogue-coordination family or to a genuinely separate population.
